texts.preamble: Oms Tamarind Merchant Private Ltd vs The Principal Secretary Union Of India on 19 February, 2024 Author: G.R.Swaminathan Bench: G.R.Swaminathan W.P(MD)No.3 Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated : 19.02.2024 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice G.R.Swaminathan W.P(MD)No.3722 of 2024 and W.M.P.(MD)No.3635 of 2024 Oms Tamarind Merchant Private Ltd., Rep. by its Authorized Signatory / Director, R.Kiruba Shankar, 185, East Masi Street, Madurai - 625 001. ... Petitioner Vs. 1.The Principal Secretary Union of India, Department of Health and Family Welfare, New Delhi. 2.The Principal Secretary Union of India, Department of Agriculture Co-Operation and Farmers Welfare, New Delhi. 3.The Principal Secretary Government of Tamil Nadu, Department of Health and Family Welfare, Fort St.George, Secretariat, Chennai. 4.The Commissioner, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, Dms Campus, 5th Floor, No.859, Anna Salai, Teynampet, Chennai - 600 006. Oms Tamarind Merchant Private Ltd vs The Principal Secretary Union Of India on 19 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118592428/ 1 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 1/4 W.P(Md)N 5.The Adjudicating Authority / District Revenue Officer, Madurai. 6.The Food Safety Officer, Food Safety Wing, Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, H and Fvv Training Campus, Viswanathapuram, Madurai - 625 014. ... Respondents Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In praying this Court to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondent and 6 not to take any coercive action as against the petitioner shop sit 185, East Masi Street, Madurai, for the non-compliance of the orders of 5th respondent dated 11.02.2022 and 07.10.2022. For Petitioner : Mr.P.Ganapathi Subramanian For Respondents : Mr.T.Villavan Kothai, Addl. Government Pleader for R3 Mr.V.B.Sundhareshwar, Central.
